summary: Jining first-party sources establish a local cadastral/real-estate-registration procedure and identify the Jining cadastral thematic layer on the Shandong public map portal. The current public portal was inspected, but no anonymous parcel feature endpoint, safe native ID, schema, CRS, or polygon was verified. No sample GeoJSON was written.
queryAndRequestOutcomes: Separate English and Chinese discovery queries were executed and recorded in city-10114-gulou.json. Official Jining pages and the current Shandong portal landing page/configuration were inspected. The linked standard-map host timed out after 15 seconds. No credentials, private tokens, unsafe lookup, CAPTCHA/Cloudflare bypass, or TLS-verification disablement was used.
cityOrLocalCustodian: Jining Municipal Natural Resources and Planning Bureau / local real-estate registration service; official Jining notice documents the cadastral-map and registration query procedure. This is local custodian evidence, but not evidence of an open parcel download API.
routesAttempted: All executed discovery URLs, methods, and outcomes are recorded in city-10114-gulou.json.
